name: Server Stats
description: CPU, RAM, temperature and GPU use in the status bar: of this computer, or of the machine hosting a workspace on a paired Orca server.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Reading the machine's CPU, memory, temperature and GPU use

settings.title: Measure
settings.description: This computer, or the machine that hosts a workspace on a paired Orca server.

settings.title: Orca server
settings.description: For a workspace's machine: the paired Orca server it is on, as `orca environment list --json` names it. Leave empty for this computer's own Orca.

settings.title: Workspace
settings.description: The workspace whose machine is measured. Take its selector from `orca worktree ps --since 30d --json`: `id:` followed by its worktreeId, or `identity:` followed by its identity key.

settings.title: Orca CLI
settings.description: The `orca` command the plugin runs to reach that server. Change it when `orca` is not on the app's PATH; `~` stands for your home folder.

settings.title: Refresh every
settings.description: Seconds between readings. This computer is read every 2 seconds. A workspace's machine every 5, since each reading starts an Orca CLI process; set 3 to 60 to change that.
